@file:w8/team-missions.js.組員 C 傳訊息來：「你的遊戲壞了」。只說「壞了」，很難修；問了才知道，他是在下: Teammate C sends a message: “Your game is broken.” Just saying “broken” makes it hard to fix; only after asking do you learn that he digs a block while it rains and cannot pick it up. A good report has five things: a title, where, steps to reproduce, expected / actual, and a screenshot and your device. First do it yourself once to make sure it really happens, then write it as a GitHub Issue; write “Fixes #number” in the PR that fixes it, and the Issue closes by itself after the merge.
